lines.text: You agree with it. It does not take the shape of a blow. It takes the shape of a sentence you finish for it.
I lost somebody. Everybody has lost somebody. There. Take it.
Thank you. That is all it ever wanted — somebody to say it out loud in a room.
The recorder clicks off. The seal was never the five takes. The seal was always a building coming down on a recordist, and now the building has one.
You are the fourth thing it caught tonight, and the last.
Demolition is booked for 06:00. The clock reads 05:5?, and the clock was always the seal, and it is nearly closed.
